findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "problee_get_contracts" is 1176 chars, far longer than this server's median (206). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "problee_list_market_comments" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.detail: Description of "problee_list_trade_fills" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.problee.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: problee_get_rules, problee_list_market_comments, problee_get_market_trades, problee_get_market_resolution_state, problee_list_trade_fills · Private data: problee_get_token_release, problee_list_collateral, problee_get_contracts, problee_get_fees, problee_list_leaderboard, problee_list_market_comments, problee_get_market_trades, problee_list_trade_fills, problee_get_positions, problee_get_balance, problee_discover_events · Public sink: problee_get_market_trades, problee_list_trade_fills, problee_get_positions, problee_list_event_types, problee_discover_events, problee_list_webhook_event_types.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: problee_get_rules, problee_list_market_comments, problee_get_market_trades, problee_get_market_resolution_state, problee_list_trade_fills · Private data: problee_get_token_release, problee_list_collateral, problee_get_contracts, problee_get_fees, problee_list_leaderboard, problee_list_market_comments, problee_get_market_trades, problee_list_trade_fills, problee_get_positions, problee_get_balance, problee_discover_events · Public sink: problee_get_market_trades, problee_list_trade_fills, problee_get_positions, problee_list_event_types, problee_discover_events, problee_list_webhook_event_types

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
